## Summary
- Add composite indexes on all metrics tables via Alembic migration for efficient aggregation queries
- Add in-memory metrics cache with configurable TTL to prevent redundant computation on metrics endpoints
- Replace eager loading of metric rows (selectinload) with SQL-based `compute_metrics_summary()` classmethods
- Limit `get_top_*` results from unbounded (`limit=None`) to `limit=10` in admin metrics endpoint
- Add metrics cleanup infrastructure with configurable retention (`metrics_retention_days`, `metrics_cleanup_enabled`)
- Invalidate metrics cache on metrics reset operations
